final_result.scope: Controlled scratch SQLite, correction and regression epochs, unique receipt credit, current scope/caller transaction boundaries and GenericAgent Oracle mutation controls.

important_attribution: Weak first reset probe checked final tier only; a pass did not prove runtime autonomy-cycle safety. Stronger cycle and fresh-ladder probes refuted it.
Accepted-main counter was loaded into current scratch harness; this is not a whole-main checkout or whole-app baseline. Exact module source/hash retained.
Native source authoring fixed the initial reset and atomic snapshot cases without running tests. Root extended probes refuted the post-marker case; root persisted epoch cutoffs and normalized UTC.
Retained scratch rows proved whole-second SQL timestamps could not order same-second dispatches around microsecond corrections. No cutoff rounding was used.

Fresh Oracle success now stores server-owned precise dispatch and verification clocks/version in the existing operation receipt. Replay does not refresh these. Strict version/type/completeness/order checks refuse contradictions; legacy coarse/unknown clocks do not earn unsupported fresh credit.
All predecessor packets and failed logs remain at their actual source identities. Earlier 229-pass/2-known-failure affected selection is not reattributed to this source.
positive_requirements: Human correction retains lifetime counts but requires NEW 5/20/50 successes; does not fabricate regression failures.
Verified regression keeps its existing 20-new-success reentry requirement.
Peer regression between eligibility and consumption refuses stale snapshot/receipt; recovery rechecks and replay does not double-credit.
Old receipts remain ineligible after active marker removal; genuinely fresh real SQL/Oracle results still re-enter.
Unknown legacy epoch clocks anchor without crediting the unknown observation; future post-anchor proof remains eligible.
Real fleet/GenericAgent public wrapper/claim/recorder/Oracle/credit positive remains, using deterministic decision driver and preapproved tool governance.
limitations: Counter/receipt integrity is not general model competence or universal autonomy qualification
No PostgreSQL runtime, multi-worker, soak or served multi-model qualification
Controlled local effects only; no live provider/business/credential/spend/deployment action
No new table, store, router or approval lifecycle
